name: Speed Test
description: Measure upload and download speed to SG/Send infrastructure. Use as a diagnostic tool before large file transfers or as a QA baseline.

methods.name: runAll
methods.description: Run download then upload test against the configured target.

methods.name: setTargetUrl
methods.description: Change the target URL before running tests.

methods.name: getLastResults
methods.description: Return the most recent test results, or null.

methods.name: measureDownloadSpeed
methods.description: Low-level: measure download speed from a URL.

methods.name: measureUploadSpeed
methods.description: Low-level: measure upload speed to a URL.
